title: Add independent OPENMP differential execution adapter
problem: OpenMP target regions can silently run on the initial host device, allowing a host result to masquerade as accelerator conformance.
example:
--route omp-cuda / omp-hip use Clang NVPTX / AMDGPU offload flags.
--route omp-spirv uses icpx -fiopenmp -fopenmp-targets=spir64.
An initial-device control returns 77 before any output case is judged.
design: Share one target-region launcher across the three compiler routes, require omp_is_initial_device() to be false, record the device number, and keep route-specific flags beside the launcher.
tradeoffs: Host fallback becomes a failed execution control, not a formatting pass. Portable tests inspect source generation and flags; they do not establish an available OpenMP device runtime.
docs: Reject an OpenMP target region that executes on the initial host device. Execution requires a working offload toolchain and accelerator; host fallback is failure.
